text: In the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, while I was among the exiles by the Chebar canal, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.
On the fifth day of the month — it was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin's exile —
the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel son of Buzi the priest, there by the Chebar canal in the land of the Chaldeans, and the LORD's hand was on him there.
I looked, and a windstorm was coming out of the north: a huge cloud with fire flashing back and forth and a brightness surrounding it, and in the center of the fire something like glowing metal.
From within it came what looked like four living creatures, and this was their appearance: they had a human form,
but each had four faces and each had four wings.
Their legs were straight, the soles of their feet like a calf's hoof, gleaming like polished bronze.
Under their wings, on all four sides, were human hands. All four had faces and wings,
and their wings touched one another. None of them turned as it moved; each one went straight ahead.
As for the form of their faces: each had the face of a human, and each of the four had a lion's face on the right and an ox's face on the left, and each also had the face of an eagle.
That is how their faces looked. Their wings spread out above them; each had two wings touching the creature on either side and two wings covering its body.
Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit wanted to go, they went, without turning as they moved.
Among the living creatures was something that looked like burning coals of fire or like torches, moving back and forth among them; the fire was bright, and lightning was flashing out of it.
The creatures themselves darted back and forth like flashes of lightning.
As I looked at the living creatures, I noticed a wheel on the ground beside each one, one for each of the four of them.
The wheels sparkled like beryl, and all four looked the same; each appeared to be a wheel within a wheel.
They could move in any of the four directions the creatures faced, without turning as they went.
Their rims were tall and awesome to look at, and all four rims were full of eyes all the way around.
When the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them; when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
Wherever the spirit wanted to go, they went, and the wheels rose right along with them, for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stopped, the wheels stopped; when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose together with them, because the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
Over the heads of the living creatures was something like an expanse, shining like awe-inspiring crystal, stretched out above their heads.
Under the expanse their wings were stretched out, one toward the other; each also had two wings covering its body.
When they moved I heard the sound of their wings, like the roar of rushing waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the noise of a great army; when they stood still, they let their wings drop.
A voice came from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.
Above the expanse over their heads was something like a throne, in appearance like sapphire, and on the throne, high above, was a figure that looked like a man.
I saw that from what appeared to be his waist upward he looked like glowing metal, as if filled with fire, and from his waist downward he looked like fire, with a brilliant light surrounding him.

Like the appearance of a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day, so was the brilliance all around him. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. When I saw it, I fell facedown, and I heard the voice of someone speaking.
